This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing specifically included files and files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where line numbers have been added.

# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

## Notes
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: **/*.c, **/*.h, **/*.ld, **/Makefile, **/*.sh
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: tinyusb/**, build/**, Drivers/**, repomix-output.xml
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

## File: src/main.c
```c
  1: #include "main.h"
  2: 
  3: ETH_HandleTypeDef heth;
  4: 
  5: // Дескрипторы Ethernet DMA в некэшируемой памяти SRAM D2 (0x30000000)
  6: __attribute__((section(".eth_dma"))) ETH_DMADescTypeDef DMARxDscrTab[4];
  7: __attribute__((section(".eth_dma"))) ETH_DMADescTypeDef DMATxDscrTab[4];
  8: __attribute__((section(".eth_dma"))) uint8_t Rx_Buff[4][1536];
  9: 
 10: static uint8_t eth_tx_buf[1536];
 11: static uint8_t eth_rx_buf[1536];
 12: 
 13: static void SystemClock_Config(void);
 14: static void MPU_Config(void);
 15: static void MX_GPIO_Init(void);
 16: static void MX_ETH_Init(void);
 17: 
 18: // Системный тик для HAL
 19: void SysTick_Handler(void) {
 20:     HAL_IncTick();
 21: }
 22: 
 23: // Прерывание USB OTG HS для передачи управления стеку TinyUSB
 24: void OTG_HS_IRQHandler(void) {
 25:     tud_int_handler(0);
 26: }
 27: 
 28: int main(void) {
 29:     MPU_Config();
 30:     HAL_Init();
 31:     SystemClock_Config();
 32:     MX_GPIO_Init();
 33:     MX_ETH_Init();
 34: 
 35:     // Запуск приема кадров Ethernet
 36:     HAL_ETH_Start_IT(&heth);
 37: 
 38:     // Инициализация TinyUSB (USB Device)
 39:     tusb_init();
 40: 
 41:     while (1) {
 42:         tud_task();
 43: 
 44:         // 1. Прием из Ethernet (RJ-45) -> Передача в USB хосту (Ubuntu)
 45:         if (tud_network_can_xmit()) {
 46:             void *p_rx = NULL;
 47:             if (HAL_ETH_ReadData(&heth, &p_rx) == HAL_OK && p_rx != NULL) {
 48:                 uint32_t rx_len = 0;
 49:                 HAL_ETH_GetRxDataLength(&heth, &rx_len);
 50:                 if (rx_len > 0) {
 51:                     tud_network_xmit(p_rx, rx_len);
 52:                 }
 53:             }
 54:         }
 55:     }
 56: }
 57: 
 58: // 2. Коллбэк TinyUSB: кадр получен из USB (от хоста) -> отправляем в кабель Ethernet
 59: bool tud_network_recv_cb(const uint8_t *src, uint16_t size) {
 60:     if (size > 0 && size <= 1514) {
 61:         memcpy(eth_tx_buf, src, size);
 62:         ETH_TxPacketConfig TxConfig = {
 63:             .Attributes = ETH_TX_PACKETS_FEATURES_CSUM | ETH_TX_PACKETS_FEATURES_CRCPAD,
 64:             .Length = size,
 65:             .TxBuffer = eth_tx_buf
 66:         };
 67:         HAL_ETH_Transmit(&heth, &TxConfig, 10);
 68:     }
 69:     tud_network_recv_renew();
 70:     return true;
 71: }
 72: 
 73: uint16_t tud_network_xmit_cb(uint8_t *dst, void *ref, uint16_t arg) {
 74:     uint16_t len = arg;
 75:     memcpy(dst, ref, len);
 76:     return len;
 77: }
 78: 
 79: void tud_network_init_cb(void) {}
 80: 
 81: // Конфигурация пинов RMII Ethernet платы Nucleo-H723ZG
 82: void HAL_ETH_MspInit(ETH_HandleTypeDef *heth_inst) {
 83:     GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct = {0};
 84: 
 85:     __HAL_RCC_SYSCFG_CLK_ENABLE();
 86:     __HAL_RCC_GPIOA_CLK_ENABLE();
 87:     __HAL_RCC_GPIOB_CLK_ENABLE();
 88:     __HAL_RCC_GPIOC_CLK_ENABLE();
 89:     __HAL_RCC_GPIOG_CLK_ENABLE();
 90: 
 91:     // Включение тактирования модуля Ethernet MAC
 92:     __HAL_RCC_ETH1MAC_CLK_ENABLE();
 93:     __HAL_RCC_ETH1TX_CLK_ENABLE();
 94:     __HAL_RCC_ETH1RX_CLK_ENABLE();
 95: 
 96:     // Выбор интерфейса RMII
 97:     HAL_SYSCFG_ETHInterfaceSelect(SYSCFG_ETH_RMII);
 98: 
 99:     GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;
100:     GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
101:     GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_VERY_HIGH;
102:     GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = GPIO_AF11_ETH;
103: 
104:     // PA1: REF_CLK, PA2: MDIO, PA7: CRS_DV
105:     GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_1 | GPIO_PIN_2 | GPIO_PIN_7;
106:     HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOA, &GPIO_InitStruct);
107: 
108:     // PB13: TXD1
109:     GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_13;
110:     HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOB, &GPIO_InitStruct);
111: 
112:     // PC1: MDC, PC4: RXD0, PC5: RXD1
113:     GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_1 | GPIO_PIN_4 | GPIO_PIN_5;
114:     HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOC, &GPIO_InitStruct);
115: 
116:     // PG11: TX_EN, PG13: TXD0
117:     GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_11 | GPIO_PIN_13;
118:     HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOG, &GPIO_InitStruct);
119: }
120: 
121: static void MX_ETH_Init(void) {
122:     heth.Instance = ETH;
123:     heth.Init.MACAddr[0] = 0x00;
124:     heth.Init.MACAddr[1] = 0x80;
125:     heth.Init.MACAddr[2] = 0xE1;
126:     heth.Init.MACAddr[3] = 0x00;
127:     heth.Init.MACAddr[4] = 0x00;
128:     heth.Init.MACAddr[5] = 0x01;
129:     heth.Init.MediaInterface = HAL_ETH_RMII_MODE;
130:     heth.Init.RxBuffLen = 1536;
131: 
132:     HAL_ETH_Init(&heth);
133:     HAL_ETH_SetMDIOClockRange(&heth);
134: 
135:     ETH_DMAConfigTypeDef dma_config = {
136:         .DMAArbitration = ETH_DMAARBITRATION_RX1_TX1
137:     };
138:     HAL_ETH_InitDMAConfig(&heth, &dma_config);
139:     HAL_ETH_RegisterRxDescList(&heth, DMARxDscrTab, &Rx_Buff[0][0], 4);
140:     HAL_ETH_RegisterTxDescList(&heth, DMATxDscrTab, 4);
141: }
142: 
143: // Тактирование: 480 МГц Core, 48 МГц USB от PLL1Q
144: static void SystemClock_Config(void) {
145:     RCC_OscInitTypeDef RCC_OscInitStruct = {0};
146:     RCC_ClkInitTypeDef RCC_ClkInitStruct = {0};
147:     RCC_PeriphCLKInitTypeDef PeriphClkInitStruct = {0};
148: 
149:     HAL_PWREx_ConfigSupply(PWR_LDO_SUPPLY);
150:     __HAL_PWR_VOLTAGESCALING_CONFIG(PWR_REGULATOR_VOLTAGE_SCALE0);
151:     while (!__HAL_PWR_GET_FLAG(PWR_FLAG_VOSRDY)) {}
152: 
153:     RCC_OscInitStruct.OscillatorType = RCC_OSCILLATORTYPE_HSE;
154:     RCC_OscInitStruct.HSEState = RCC_HSE_BYPASS;
155:     RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLState = RCC_PLL_ON;
156:     RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLSource = RCC_PLLSOURCE_HSE;
157:     RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLM = 2;
158:     RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLN = 240;
159:     RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLP = 1;     // CPU: 480 MHz
160:     RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLQ = 10;    // USB: 48 MHz
161:     RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLR = 2;
162:     HAL_RCC_OscConfig(&RCC_OscInitStruct);
163: 
164:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.ClockType = RCC_CLOCKTYPE_HCLK | RCC_CLOCKTYPE_SYSCLK |
165:                                   RCC_CLOCKTYPE_PCLK1 | RCC_CLOCKTYPE_PCLK2 |
166:                                   RCC_CLOCKTYPE_D3PCLK1 | RCC_CLOCKTYPE_D1PCLK1;
167:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.SYSCLKSource = RCC_SYSCLKSOURCE_PLLCLK;
168:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.SYSCLKDivider = RCC_SYSCLK_DIV1;
169:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.AHBCLKDivider = RCC_HCLK_DIV2; // AXI: 240 MHz
170:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.APB1CLKDivider = RCC_APB1_DIV2;
171:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.APB2CLKDivider = RCC_APB2_DIV2;
172:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.APB3CLKDivider = RCC_APB3_DIV2;
173:     RCC_ClkInitStruct.APB4CLKDivider = RCC_APB4_DIV2;
174:     HAL_RCC_ClockConfig(&RCC_ClkInitStruct, FLASH_LATENCY_3);
175: 
176:     PeriphClkInitStruct.PeriphClockSelection = RCC_PERIPHCLK_USB;
177:     PeriphClkInitStruct.UsbClockSelection = RCC_USBCLKSOURCE_PLL;
178:     HAL_RCCEx_PeriphCLKConfig(&PeriphClkInitStruct);
179: }
180: 
181: // Защита памяти: область дескрипторов DMA в SRAM D2 должна быть некэшируемой
182: static void MPU_Config(void) {
183:     MPU_Region_InitTypeDef MPU_InitStruct = {0};
184:     HAL_MPU_Disable();
185: 
186:     MPU_InitStruct.Enable = MPU_REGION_ENABLE;
187:     MPU_InitStruct.Number = MPU_REGION_NUMBER0;
188:     MPU_InitStruct.BaseAddress = 0x30000000;
189:     MPU_InitStruct.Size = MPU_REGION_SIZE_32KB;
190:     MPU_InitStruct.SubRegionDisable = 0x0;
191:     MPU_InitStruct.TypeExtField = MPU_TEX_LEVEL0;
192:     MPU_InitStruct.AccessPermission = MPU_REGION_FULL_ACCESS;
193:     MPU_InitStruct.DisableExec = MPU_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS_DISABLE;
194:     MPU_InitStruct.IsShareable = MPU_ACCESS_SHAREABLE;
195:     MPU_InitStruct.IsCacheable = MPU_ACCESS_NOT_CACHEABLE;
196:     MPU_InitStruct.IsBufferable = MPU_ACCESS_NOT_BUFFERABLE;
197:     HAL_MPU_ConfigRegion(&MPU_InitStruct);
198: 
199:     HAL_MPU_Enable(MPU_PRIVILEGED_DEFAULT);
200: }
201: 
202: static void MX_GPIO_Init(void) {
203:     __HAL_RCC_GPIOA_CLK_ENABLE();
204:     __HAL_RCC_GPIOB_CLK_ENABLE();
205: 
206:     // Пины PA11 (DM) и PA12 (DP) для USB CN13
207:     GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct = {0};
208:     GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_11 | GPIO_PIN_12;
209:     GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;
210:     GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;
211:     GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_VERY_HIGH;
212:     GPIO_InitStruct.Alternate = GPIO_AF10_OTG1_FS;
213:     HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOA, &GPIO_InitStruct);
214: 
215:     // Тактирование и прерывание контроллера USB OTG HS
216:     __HAL_RCC_USB1_OTG_HS_CLK_ENABLE();
217:     HAL_NVIC_SetPriority(OTG_HS_IRQn, 6, 0);
218:     HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ(OTG_HS_IRQn);
219: }
```

## File: src/usb_descriptors.c
```c
 1: #include "tusb.h"
 2: 
 3: // VID/PID (тестовый Realtek-совместимый или ST)
 4: #define USB_VID   0xcafe
 5: #define USB_PID   0x4002
 6: 
 7: tusb_desc_device_t const desc_device = {
 8:     .bLength            = sizeof(tusb_desc_device_t),
 9:     .bDescriptorType    = TUSB_DESC_DEVICE,
10:     .bcdUSB             = 0x0200,
11:     .bDeviceClass       = TUSB_CLASS_CDC,
12:     .bDeviceSubClass    = CDC_COMM_SUBCLASS_ETHERNET_CONTROL_MODEL,
13:     .bDeviceProtocol    = 0x00,
14:     .bMaxPacketSize0    = CFG_TUD_ENDPOINT0_SIZE,
15:     .idVendor           = USB_VID,
16:     .idProduct          = USB_PID,
17:     .bcdDevice          = 0x0100,
18:     .iManufacturer      = 0x01,
19:     .iProduct           = 0x02,
20:     .iSerialNumber      = 0x03,
21:     .bNumConfigurations = 0x01
22: };
23: 
24: uint8_t const * tud_descriptor_device_cb(void) {
25:     return (uint8_t const *) &desc_device;
26: }
27: 
28: enum {
29:     ITF_NUM_CDC_CONTROL = 0,
30:     ITF_NUM_CDC_DATA,
31:     ITF_NUM_TOTAL
32: };
33: 
34: #define EPNUM_NET_NOTIF   0x81
35: #define EPNUM_NET_OUT     0x02
36: #define EPNUM_NET_IN      0x82
37: 
38: #define CONFIG_TOTAL_LEN  (TUD_CONFIG_DESC_LEN + TUD_CDC_ECM_DESC_LEN)
39: 
40: uint8_t const desc_configuration[] = {
41:     // Конфигурационный дескриптор
42:     TUD_CONFIG_DESCRIPTOR(1, ITF_NUM_TOTAL, 0, CONFIG_TOTAL_LEN, 0, 100),
43:     // CDC-ECM дескриптор (MAC-адрес передается хосту в строке 4)
44:     TUD_CDC_ECM_DESCRIPTOR(ITF_NUM_CDC_CONTROL, 4, EPNUM_NET_NOTIF, 64, EPNUM_NET_OUT, EPNUM_NET_IN, CFG_TUD_NET_ENDPOINT_SIZE, CFG_TUD_NET_MTU)
45: };
46: 
47: uint8_t const * tud_descriptor_configuration_cb(uint8_t index) {
48:     (void) index;
49:     return desc_configuration;
50: }
51: 
52: // Строковые дескрипторы (включая виртуальный MAC-адрес)
53: char const* string_desc_arr[] = {
54:     (const char[]) { 0x09, 0x04 }, // 0: English
55:     "TinyUSB",                     // 1: Manufacturer
56:     "STM32H7 Bridge",              // 2: Product
57:     "1234567890AB",                // 3: Serial
58:     "001A2B3C4D5E",                // 4: MAC Address для Ubuntu (12 hex символов)
59: };
60: 
61: static uint16_t _desc_str[32];
62: uint16_t const* tud_descriptor_string_cb(uint8_t index, uint16_t langid) {
63:     (void) langid;
64:     uint8_t count;
65: 
66:     if (index == 0) {
67:         memcpy(&_desc_str[1], string_desc_arr[0], 2);
68:         count = 1;
69:     } else {
70:         if (index >= sizeof(string_desc_arr)/sizeof(string_desc_arr[0])) return NULL;
71:         const char* str = string_desc_arr[index];
72:         count = strlen(str);
73:         for(uint8_t i=0; i<count; i++) _desc_str[1+i] = str[i];
74:     }
75: 
76:     _desc_str[0] = (TUSB_DESC_STRING << 8) | (2 * count + 2);
77:     return _desc_str;
78: }
79: 
80: const uint8_t tud_network_mac_address[6] = { 0x00, 0x1A, 0x2B, 0x3C, 0x4D, 0x5E };
```

## File: bootstrap.sh
```bash
 1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
 2: set -e
 3: 
 4: echo "=== Загрузка CMSIS, HAL и TinyUSB ==="
 5: mkdir -p Drivers/CMSIS Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver
 6: 
 7: # CMSIS Core (ARM)
 8: if [ ! -d "Drivers/CMSIS/Core" ]; then
 9:     git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_5.git /tmp/cmsis5
10:     mv /tmp/cmsis5/CMSIS/Core Drivers/CMSIS/Core
11:     rm -rf /tmp/cmsis5
12: fi
13: 
14: # CMSIS Device STM32H7
15: if [ ! -d "Drivers/CMSIS/Device" ]; then
16:     git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis_device_h7.git Drivers/CMSIS/Device
17: fi
18: 
19: # STM32H7xx HAL Driver
20: if [ ! -d "Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src" ]; then
21:     git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32h7xx_hal_driver.git Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver
22: fi
23: 
24: # TinyUSB stack
25: if [ ! -d "tinyusb" ]; then
26:     git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/hathach/tinyusb.git tinyusb
27: fi
28: 
29: echo "=== Все библиотеки успешно загружены! ==="
```

## File: Makefile
```makefile
 1: TARGET = nucleo_h723_bridge
 2: BUILD_DIR = build
 3: 
 4: # Тулчейн
 5: PREFIX = arm-none-eabi-
 6: CC = $(PREFIX)gcc
 7: AS = $(PREFIX)gcc -x assembler-with-cpp
 8: CP = $(PREFIX)objcopy
 9: SZ = $(PREFIX)size
10: 
11: # Флаги архитектуры Cortex-M7
12: MCU = -mcpu=cortex-m7 -mthumb -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard
13: 
14: # Макросы препроцессора
15: C_DEFS = \
16:     -DSTM32H723xx \
17:     -DUSE_HAL_DRIVER \
18:     -DCFG_TUSB_MCU=OPT_MCU_STM32H7
19: 
20: # Пути к заголовкам (исправлен путь CMSIS Device)
21: C_INCLUDES = \
22:     -Iinc \
23:     -IDrivers/CMSIS/Core/Include \
24:     -IDrivers/CMSIS/Device/Include \
25:     -IDrivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Inc \
26:     -Itinyusb/src
27: 
28: # Исходные файлы C
29: C_SOURCES = \
30:     src/main.c \
31:     src/usb_descriptors.c \
32:     Drivers/CMSIS/Device/Source/Templates/system_stm32h7xx.c \
33:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal.c \
34:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_cortex.c \
35:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_rcc.c \
36:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_rcc_ex.c \
37:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_pwr.c \
38:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_pwr_ex.c \
39:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_gpio.c \
40:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_dma.c \
41:     Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32h7xx_hal_eth.c \
42:     tinyusb/src/tusb.c \
43:     tinyusb/src/common/tusb_fifo.c \
44:     tinyusb/src/device/usbd.c \
45:     tinyusb/src/device/usbd_control.c \
46:     tinyusb/src/class/net/net_device.c \
47:     tinyusb/src/portable/synopsys/dwc2/dcd_dwc2.c
48: 
49: # Ассемблерный файл стартапа
50: ASM_SOURCES = \
51:     Drivers/CMSIS/Device/Source/Templates/gcc/startup_stm32h723xx.s
52: 
53: # Флаги компилятора
54: CFLAGS = $(MCU) $(C_DEFS) $(C_INCLUDES) -O2 -g3 -Wall -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections
55: 
56: # Флаги линковщика
57: LDSCRIPT = STM32H723ZGT6.ld
58: LDFLAGS = $(MCU) -T$(LDSCRIPT) --specs=nano.specs --specs=nosys.specs \
59:           -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-Map=$(BUILD_DIR)/$(TARGET).map,--cref -lc -lm
60: 
61: OBJECTS = $(addprefix $(BUILD_DIR)/,$(notdir $(C_SOURCES:.c=.o)))
62: vpath %.c $(sort $(dir $(C_SOURCES)))
63: OBJECTS += $(addprefix $(BUILD_DIR)/,$(notdir $(ASM_SOURCES:.s=.o)))
64: vpath %.s $(sort $(dir $(ASM_SOURCES)))
65: 
66: all: $(BUILD_DIR)/$(TARGET).elf $(BUILD_DIR)/$(TARGET).bin $(BUILD_DIR)/$(TARGET).hex
67: 
68: $(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: %.c Makefile | $(BUILD_DIR) 
69: 	@echo "CC $<"
70: 	@$(CC) -c $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@
71: 
72: $(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: %.s Makefile | $(BUILD_DIR)
73: 	@echo "AS $<"
74: 	@$(AS) -c $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@
75: 
76: $(BUILD_DIR)/$(TARGET).elf: $(OBJECTS) Makefile
77: 	@echo "LD $@"
78: 	@$(CC) $(OBJECTS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@
79: 	@$(SZ) $@
80: 
81: $(BUILD_DIR)/%.bin: $(BUILD_DIR)/%.elf | $(BUILD_DIR)
82: 	@$(CP) -O binary -S $< $@
83: 
84: $(BUILD_DIR)/%.hex: $(BUILD_DIR)/%.elf | $(BUILD_DIR)
85: 	@$(CP) -O ihex $< $@
86: 
87: $(BUILD_DIR):
88: 	mkdir $@
89: 
90: clean:
91: 	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR)
92: 
93: flash: $(BUILD_DIR)/$(TARGET).bin
94: 	st-flash write $(BUILD_DIR)/$(TARGET).bin 0x08000000
95: 
96: .PHONY: all clean flash
```

## File: STM32H723ZGT6.ld
```
 1: ENTRY(Reset_Handler)
 2: 
 3: _estack = ORIGIN(DTCM) + LENGTH(DTCM);
 4: 
 5: MEMORY
 6: {
 7:     FLASH (rx)      : ORIGIN = 0x08000000, LENGTH = 1024K
 8:     DTCM (xrw)      : ORIGIN = 0x20000000, LENGTH = 128K
 9:     AXI_SRAM (xrw)  : ORIGIN = 0x24000000, LENGTH = 320K
10:     SRAM_D2 (xrw)   : ORIGIN = 0x30000000, LENGTH = 32K
11: }
12: 
13: SECTIONS
14: {
15:     .isr_vector : {
16:         . = ALIGN(4);
17:         KEEP(*(.isr_vector))
18:         . = ALIGN(4);
19:     } > FLASH
20: 
21:     .text : {
22:         . = ALIGN(4);
23:         *(.text)
24:         *(.text*)
25:         *(.rodata)
26:         *(.rodata*)
27:         . = ALIGN(4);
28:         _etext = .;
29:     } > FLASH
30: 
31:     _sidata = LOADADDR(.data);
32:     .data : {
33:         . = ALIGN(4);
34:         _sdata = .;
35:         *(.data)
36:         *(.data*)
37:         . = ALIGN(4);
38:         _edata = .;
39:     } > AXI_SRAM AT> FLASH
40: 
41:     .bss : {
42:         . = ALIGN(4);
43:         _sbss = .;
44:         *(.bss)
45:         *(.bss*)
46:         *(COMMON)
47:         . = ALIGN(4);
48:         _ebss = .;
49:     } > AXI_SRAM
50: 
51:     /* Выделенная область в SRAM D2 для дескрипторов и буферов Ethernet DMA */
52:     .eth_dma (NOLOAD) : {
53:         . = ALIGN(4);
54:         *(.eth_dma*)
55:         . = ALIGN(4);
56:     } > SRAM_D2
57: }
```
